title: City Sights Tour
nearby_text: See modern Singapore and its architectural wonders.

title: City Hall
nearby_text: Enter the heart of City Hall, where you will find landmarks like St Andrew’s Cathedral, offering a glimpse of our colonial past. Not far away, the iconic Fullerton Hotel stands as a testament to the city’s history, while modern-day government institutions, like the Parliament house and Supreme Court showcase Singapore’s evolution

title: Civic District
nearby_text: Witness the growth and progress of Singapore as you contrast old national monuments such as the National Gallery and the Victoria Concert Hall, against modern skyscrapers in the Central Business District. Hear stories of some of Singapore’s most significant moments in history.

title: Merlion Park (30-minute stopover)
nearby_text: An icon of Singapore, the Merlion was unveiled in 1972 to welcome all visitors to our sunny island. This is a great spot to take photos against the iconic Marina Bay and the city skyline.

title: Gardens by the Bay (30-minute stopover)
nearby_text: Explore the award-winning garden in the heart of the city, featuring more than 500,000 plants across more than 2,200 species. Marvel at the Avatar-like Supertrees that come to life in a display of lights and sounds at night.

title: Optional add-on: Garden Cruiser Audio Tour*
nearby_heading: Optional add-on: Garden Cruiser Audio Tour*
nearby_text:
Enhance your experience at Gardens by the Bay by taking a ride on a special cruiser, with commentary that offers deeper insights into the garden’s horticultural landscape.

*Add-on is optional and comes with an additional cost, at your own expense. Payment will be collected during the tour.
itinerary_titles: Optional add-on: Garden Cruiser Audio Tour*

title: [NEW] Sentosa Discovery Tour
nearby_text: Experience Singapore’s southern coast and discover how Sentosa transformed from a former British military base into a vibrant leisure destination.

title: City Sights Tour
nearby_text: Experience the best of Singapore in this dynamic city tour! From awe-inspiring architectural wonders to lush green spaces, this tour offers a snapshot of what makes Singapore a world-class city.

title: Singapore River and Marina Bay Sands Tour
nearby_heading: Singapore River and Marina Bay Sands Tour
nearby_text: Trace Singapore’s transformation from a historic trading port to a futuristic city as you explore the iconic Singapore River and Marina Bay Sands.

title: Heritage and Culture Tour
nearby_text: Perfect for heritage and culture enthusiasts, this tour offers an immersive journey through Singapore’s storied past. Explore vibrant ethnic enclaves and discover a cultural diversity that defines this modern city.

title: Heritage and Culture Tour
nearby_text: Discover Singapore's colonial past and cultural districts

title: Central Business District
nearby_text:
Singapore’s financial and commercial district impresses with its modern skyscrapers.

Situated in the middle is Singapore’s most historic Hawker Centre, Lau Pa Sat, home to a variety of local hawker fare and a bustling night street food scene.

title: Chinatown (30-minute stopover)
nearby_text: Chinatown is a culturally rich precinct featuring a mix of pre-war shophouses and iconic places of worship. Explore street murals painted by local artists that depict the daily lives of locals in the past.

title: Optional add-on: Chinatown Heritage Centre*
nearby_text:
Get a glimpse of the various iconic landmarks of Singapore scattered around Marina Bay. Keep this modern view in mind and contrast it with what you will see in ‘olden Singapore’ later.

*Add-on is optional and payable. Payment is to be made during the tour.

title: Singapore River
nearby_text: Known as the lifeline of Singapore, the Singapore River and its quays were where the economy of Singapore began. You will be able to see the former godowns and warehouses along Boat Quay and Clarke Quay as you cross the river.

title: Kampong Gelam (30-minute stopover)
nearby_text: One of Singapore’s oldest urban quarters. Kampong Gelam is an alluring neighbourhood where age-old traditions meet trendy lifestyles. With a strong Malay-Arab influence, admire the golden dome of the Sultan Mosque set amidst modern art galleries and cafes.

title: SENTOSA DISCOVERY TOUR
nearby_text: Explore Sentosa’s scenic coast and iconic attractions

title: Sentosa
nearby_text:
Singapore's premier island resort getaway, spanning 500 hectares of lush tropical landscape and golden beaches just 15 minutes from the city centre.

This vibrant destination seamlessly blends nature, adventure, and premium and differentiated resorts, offering everything from peaceful nature walks to thrilling attractions.

title: Universal Studios Singapore, Resorts World Sentosa
nearby_heading: Universal Studios Singapore, Resorts World Sentosa
nearby_text:
Universal Studios Singapore is nestled within Resorts World Sentosa, a premier integrated resort offering diverse entertainment across 49 hectares. This world-class destination combines thrilling theme park attractions with luxury accommodations, dining, and unique experiences all in one location.

Capture the perfect photo with the iconic Universal globe – the stunning landmark that welcomes visitors to Southeast Asia's first and only Universal Studios theme park, where immersive movie-themed attractions and exhilarating rides bring beloved blockbusters to life.

Beyond the theme park experience, the integrated resort also houses the Singapore Oceanarium, Adventure Cove Waterpark, and eight premium hotels.

itinerary_titles: Universal Studios Singapore, Resorts World Sentosa

title: Sentosa Sensoryscape
nearby_text:
One of the newest additions to Sentosa, Sentosa Sensoryscape is a one-of-a-kind, multi-sensory experience that links Resorts World Sentosa to the beach areas via an immersive 350-metre walking trail.

Explore six enchanting sensory gardens that awaken all your senses through captivating experiences blending nature, architecture, and innovative technology.

title: Siloso Beach
nearby_text:
The most energetic and activity-filled stretch of coastline on Sentosa.

Known for its vibrant beach culture, Siloso is where you’ll find beach volleyball courts, water sports rentals, and a lively atmosphere with buzzing beach clubsthat draws locals and tourists all day!

title: Optional add-on for 3pm tour*
nearby_text:
Singapore Cable Car – Sentosa Line.

See Sentosa from a new perspective. Soar above the island’s vibrant attractions and golden tropical shorelines on the Singapore Cable Car Sentosa Line. It’s the ultimate shortcut to the best views in the city, offering a breathtaking look at Sentosa’s beaches and skyline from high above the trees.

*Add-on is optional and comes with an additional cost, at your own expense. Payment will be collected during the tour. Please note that this option is only available for the 3pm tour.

title: Optional add-on for 7pm tour*: Wings of Time Fireworks Symphony
nearby_heading: Optional add-on for 7pm tour*: Wings of Time Fireworks Symphony
nearby_text:
Enhance your experience with Singapore’s only daily fireworks show at Siloso Beach. Set against the open sea, this dazzling spectacle features fireworks, laser lights, water jets, and moving musical soundtrack

*Add-on is optional and comes with an additional cost, at your own expense. Payment will be collected during the tour.

title: Clarke Quay

page_title: SINGAPORE RIVER AND MARINA BAY SANDS TOUR
title: Singapore River (30-minute stopover)
nearby_text: Follow the path of the Singapore River, the lifeblood of Singapore’s early trading days. Learn how this historic waterway transformed from a busy port filled with bumboats into a picturesque promenade, lined with beautifully preserved shophouses and cultural sites.

page_title: SINGAPORE RIVER AND MARINA BAY SANDS TOUR
title: Optional add-on: Singapore River Cruise*
nearby_text:
Enhance your experience by gliding along the Singapore River on a scenic cruise. Board an electric bumboat and enjoy a relaxing ride into Marina Bay, while listening to insightful commentary about Singapore’s journey from a colonial trading post to a global metropolis.

*Add-on is optional and comes with an additional cost, at your own expense. Payment will be collected during the tour.

page_title: SINGAPORE RIVER AND MARINA BAY SANDS TOUR
title: Marina Bay Waterfront
nearby_text: As you approach Marina Bay, marvel at the city’s breathtaking skyline with impressive structures like the ArtScience Museum and the soaring skyscrapers of the Central Business District.

title: Marina Bay Sands Shoppes and Hotel (30 min stopover)
alt: Marina Bay Sands Shoppes and Hotel (30 min stopover)
nearby_heading: Marina Bay Sands Shoppes and Hotel (30 min stopover)
nearby_text: Explore one of Singapore’s most luxurious destinations, housing designer brands, celebrity-chef restaurants and an indoor canal with gondola rides. Above it all, the iconic MBS Hotel rises majestically, home to the world’s largest infinity pool.
